scope: One original synthetic diagnostic qualification, not card or engine admission
pre_dispatch: Reconcile live recovery CURRENT, exact foreground owner/lease, disabled scheduled executor, no newer receipt/successor, and all active workflow statuses/events. Never take over an expired lease without release evidence.

Require explicit authorization for the proposed new .github/workflows/manual-quarantine-prior-spell-diagnostic-r1.yml activation path before creating that path. The draft lives in the already authorized research directory.
Source commit parent is the frozen base; all source changes are additive authorized test or research files. Every existing file must retain its exact Git object identity.
Validation Git object parent is exact source; tree delta is exactly the one new workflow. No auxiliary ref.

Freeze validation/source/tree/protocol/workflow blob in recovery CURRENT; immutable and live readback. Dispatch commit parents are recovery freeze first and validation second; first-parent tree delta only new workflow.

Push exclusively to recovery branch once; read-only Actions permissions, noncancelling Manual concurrency, run_number=1 and attempt=1 guards. No accepted workflow is edited or repurposed. Ledger-only pushes cannot trigger the new path filter.
compile_and_behavior: All normal plus four isolated mutant forms compile before behavior. Exactly24 normal,24 restored,24 cases per negative form,4+4+6+4=18 exact negative assertion witnesses; zero skips/errors/unrelated failures. Preserve original stdout/JUnit/exit codes, every source form, patches, protocol and workflow bytes; restore even after failure.
receiving: Reconcile newer receipts before any download; original artifact once. Never re-receive accepted source-departure or archived R1 artifacts.

Read exact GitHub run and attempt-specific jobs, artifact metadata, immutable source/validation/event commits and trees. Save raw metadata in RECEIVING_PINS.json and bind run/job/attempt/artifact to the dispatch checkpoint.

Verify terminal status, recovery branch, push event, event head, matching workflow blob on both parents, source parent/tree, protocol blob, artifact ID/bytes/digest, original ZIP member multiplicity and safe paths, both complete manifests.

Recompute base/source trees from raw Git tree inventories; every existing file must be unchanged. Verify full normal/mutant source form bytes and protocol/harness files against immutable source blobs.

Audit raw JUnit identities/multiplicities/counts/skips and exact assertion type/file/line/expected/actual. Require compilation of every form before accepting behavioral evidence. Verify restored normal and final rebinding.

Preserve original ZIP bytes and raw reports, including all failure evidence, in immutable recovery-lineage archive parts with index/digests. Record receipt only after verified immutable/live readback.

Green workflow alone is not acceptance. On failure retain original diagnostics; compiler/missing-report/integrity failures are not behavioral negatives. No automatic unchanged rerun. If an engine defect is demonstrated, propose the smallest bounded production repair without implementing it.

pin_file_shape.jobs: raw GET actions/runs/<id>/attempts/1/jobs with all pages reconciled

safeguards: No shipping production/SDK, Surge/card/OGW snapshots/teammates, multiplayer/games/seeds, spending/schedule/executor changes; preserve v0.7, protected originals, all assertions/fixtures, evidence, statistical design, budgets and both Precision games. Canonical remains quarantined read-only.
